log_level.description: Logging verbosity (debug, info, warn, error, critical). Default is warn if not specified.

run_dir.description: Directory for runtime files (e.g., Unix sockets)

allowed_interfaces.description: List of network interface names allowed to carry MPTCP subflows (leave empty to allow all)

blocked_interfaces.description: List of network interface names explicitly disallowed for MPTCP subflows
